FAQ

Are my images uploaded?

No. This tool uses your browser’s canvas to process images locally. Nothing is sent to a server.

Why can a PNG get bigger?

PNG is a lossless format. For photos, exporting as JPG or WebP usually produces a much smaller file.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes. Use your phone’s file picker or share sheet to select multiple supported images.
